Content-Location: https://web.telegram.org/a/assets/extra-or8QPh88.css @charset "utf-8"; .MediaViewerActions { margin-inline: auto -0.375rem; display: flex; } .MediaViewerActions .Button { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); margin-inline-start: 0.25rem; } .MediaViewerActions-mobile { color: var(--color-text); position: relative; } .MediaViewerActions-mobile .ProgressSpinner { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; } .MediaViewerActions-mobile .Button { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); } .MediaViewerFooter { width: 100%; padding: 1rem 0px; transition: opacity 0.15s; position: absolute; bottom: 0px; } .MediaViewerFooter.mobile { background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0%, rgb(0, 0, 0) 100%); } .MediaViewerFooter.mobile.is-for-video { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; padding-bottom: 5rem; } .video-controls-visible .MediaViewerFooter.mobile.is-for-video:not(.is-hidden) { pointer-events: auto; opacity: 1; } .MediaViewerFooter.mobile .media-viewer-footer-content { z-index: 1; opacity: 1; } .MediaViewerFooter.mobile .media-text.multiline::before { background: 0px 0px; display: none; } body.ghost-animating .MediaViewerFooter { opacity: 0; } .MediaViewerFooter .media-viewer-footer-content { cursor: var(--custom-cursor,pointer); max-width: var(--messages-container-width); opacity: 0.5; margin: auto; transition: opacity 0.15s; position: relative; } .MediaViewerFooter .media-viewer-footer-content:hover { opacity: 1; } .MediaViewerFooter.is-hidden { opacity: 0; } .MediaViewerFooter .media-text { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.025rem; max-height: 4.25rem; margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; overflow: auto; } .MediaViewerFooter .media-text .emoji:not(.custom-emoji) { vertical-align: -2px; width: 0.9375rem; height: 0.9375rem; } .MediaViewerFooter .media-text.multiline::before { content: ""; z-index: var(--z-below); border-radius: var(--border-radius-default); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75); position: absolute; inset: -0.25rem -0.75rem; } @media (height <= 640px) { .MediaViewerFooter .media-text { max-height: 2.75rem; } } .MediaViewerFooter a { color:
